csv_scope_of_work: The City of Johnson, Arkansas, in partnership with the Northwest Arkansas District Council of the Urban Land Institute (ULI NWA), seeks statements of qualifications from multidisciplinary planning, urban design, engineering, and related professional consultant teams to assist the City in the preparation of a Comprehensive Plan Update. The City seeks a consultant team capable of helping Johnson preserve and strengthen its distinct small-town identity and business culture while planning thoughtfully for anticipated growth and long-term community sustainability.
